description: This file contains implementation of the Metadata class, including methods for walking through metadata, rebasing values, and handling metadata collection and aggregation logic within the GN build system.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class responsible for handling metadata collection, walking, rebasing, and aggregation within the GN build system.

methods.name: WalkStep
methods.description: Performs a walk step over metadata, collecting data based on specified keys and walk keys, and prepares the next set of keys for further traversal.

methods.name: RebaseValue
methods.description: Rebases a metadata value according to the specified rebase directory, handling different value types.

methods.name: RebaseStringValue
methods.description: Rebases a string metadata value to a new path based on the rebase directory.

methods.name: RebaseListValue
methods.description: Rebases a list of metadata values.

methods.name: RebaseScopeValue
methods.description: Rebases a scope (dictionary) of metadata values.
